claim_text: The average global prevalence of NF1 is about 1 case per 3,000 individuals, with country estimates ranging from 1 per 960 in Israel to 1 per 7,812 in Russia.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 2 Uusitalo 2015 PMID 25354145. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.The review attributes the global figure and range to ref 2, which is a Finnish population study; the range itself is as stated by the review.
